claim: Characterization from targeted genuine renders plus a diagnostic held-out wet comparison. Not an equivalence claim.
probes: synthesized 1 kHz sines: 21-step staircase -60..0 dBFS peak (3 dB, 150 ms/step); burst -40/-6/-40 dBFS (0.3/0.4/0.6 s). All renders RCompressor Mono, 48 kHz, block 512, Manual, Smooth.

static_curve.law: gain = (1-b)*min(1, q + 1.5*q^2*(1-q)) + b, q = 1/(1 + m/10^(threshold/20)), m = detector peak
static_curve.evidence: steady per-sample gain y/x is constant within each step; T/S = 10^(thr/20) exact at -12/-20/-30 dB; shape 1.5; max fit error 5e-5 dB (Ratio 2, -12 dB)
static_curve.knee: no separate knee: gain is exactly 1 while 1.5*q^2 >= 1 (q >= 0.8165), i.e. below threshold - 12.96 dB
static_curve.ratio_floor_note: b is threshold-independent; no closed form recovered; table is measured, interpolation provisional. Ratio 4.01 floor measured at Threshold -12 (the held-out capture is Threshold -24) because b is threshold-independent.
static_curve.coefficient_slots_2_3: Consistent with coefficients 2/3 = thresholdScale/slope (only their ratio is observable) but no exported writer confirms the slot assignment; not claimed.

ballistics.attack: Attack 0.5/16/100 ms -> measured 50%->10% decay tau 0.62/15.5/100.0 ms: Attack feeds the gain-decrease memory via the recovered law pow(e^-1, 1/(fs*ms*1e-3)), no x5 flag.
ballistics.release: Release 50/160/500 ms (Manual) is NOT a one-pole: recovery is near-linear in gain and passes through the kernel ARC table product (param_8[0xf]); d7d0 tables not recovered. Implementation uses a PROVISIONAL one-pole of Release.

comparison.held_out: stored genuine wet capture Threshold -24, Ratio 4.01, Attack 0.5, Release 160, Manual, Smooth, probe.wav; not used for fitting
comparison.verdict: FAIL under the strict thresholds (diagnostic). Remaining error attributed to provisional release (ARC tables), approximate maximum-history tree, phase branches/ceiling release unset.
